description: This Java class 'LiteralSubscriptions' manages local subscriptions for distribution of topic data as hash code sequences within a pub/sub system. It handles subscription creation, updates, and comparison functionalities, extending the abstract class 'AbstractSubscriptions'.

classes.name: LiteralSubscriptions
classes.description: Manages local topic subscriptions, providing methods for creating, exporting, and comparing subscription states.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LiteralSubscriptions with empty subscription data.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the current subscription updates, optionally forcing a full update.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another LiteralSubscriptions object, considering updates and superclass data.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on updates and superclass hash.
